## Silo September 2026 Release  [Print](https://support.authentic8.com/support/solutions/articles/16000240348-silo-september-2026-release\# "Print this Article")

Modified on: Mon, Sep 14, 2026 at 11:04 AM

* * *

**Release Date:** September 9, 2026

**Improvements**

- API
  - A new API call now exists to access the egresses available to your account.
  - New API functionality to view whether a user is locked or not, as well as to unlock the user if needed.

**Bug Fixes**

- Fixed some issues with Read-Only mode not enabling correctly.
- Fixed a “restricted field” error that blocked the LinkedIn web app when it was provisioned as a shared or admin-controlled app.
- Fixed an issue where the organization menu in Admin Console didn’t fully expand.

For any additional questions, please contact [Authentic8 Support](https://support.authentic8.com/support/tickets/new).
